skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understanding financial mathematics concepts including interest rates, discounting cash flows, and valuation methods.
Ability to use Excel for financial modeling and calculations.
Knowledge of stochastic processes and their application in financial modeling.
Understanding of derivative pricing models and their implementation.
Ability to apply risk management principles in financial contexts.
Proficiency in performing random calculations using appropriate software tools.
Comprehension of martingale theory and its applications in finance.
